snippet.title: OMSI 2 Project Numazu DLC – Official Trailer 1 (4K)
snippet.description:
🎮 OMSI 2 Project Numazu DLC – Official Trailer 1

Discover Numazu, Japan’s coastal city, now brought to life in OMSI 2.  
Drive authentic Japanese buses through bustling streets, scenic coastlines, and anime-inspired landmarks.  

🚍 Routes: N13 & N45 – From Numazu Station to Numazu Port  
📍 Landmarks: Numazu Fish Market, Mount Fuji, Mount Ashitaka, Uchiura seaside  

📺 Showcase at Tokyo Game Show 2025!
🛒 Buy it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3880120/OMSI_2_Addon_Project_Numazu/?curator_clanid=4777282
💬 Join our community on Discord: https://discord.gg/S6bSWSdck4
